title.vi: Part 1 · Thành phố hay nông thôn?

prompt: Do you prefer living in a city or in the countryside? Why?

note.vi: Phát âm không thể hiện được qua văn bản: điểm P là minh họa, ghi chú mô tả cách nói (nhấn âm, ngữ điệu, nối âm) của người nói ở band này.
note.en: Pronunciation cannot be shown in writing: the P band is illustrative and the notes describe how a speaker at this band typically sounds (stress, intonation, linking).
note.ja: 発音は文字では示せません。Pのバンドは例示で、注記はこのバンドの話者の典型的な話し方（強勢・抑揚・連結）を説明します。
note.ru: Произношение нельзя показать письменно: балл P условный, а комментарии описывают, как обычно звучит говорящий этого уровня (ударение, интонация, связность).

note.vi: Ngập ngừng ('er', 'um'), lặp từ; câu trả lời ngắn.
note.en: Hesitation ('er', 'um') and repetition; a short answer.
note.ja: Hesitation ('er', 'um') and repetition; a short answer.
note.ru: Hesitation ('er', 'um') and repetition; a short answer.

note.vi: 'many thing to do', 'convenient' — đủ nhưng hẹp.
note.en: 'many thing to do', 'convenient' — adequate but narrow.
note.ja: 'many thing to do', 'convenient' — adequate but narrow.
note.ru: 'many thing to do', 'convenient' — adequate but narrow.

note.en: 'I prefer city', 'there is many', 'I live in city since' (needs present perfect).
note.ja: 'I prefer city', 'there is many', 'I live in city since' (needs present perfect).
note.ru: 'I prefer city', 'there is many', 'I live in city since' (needs present perfect).

samples.text: I prefer city. Because in city there is many... many thing to do, like shopping, and, er, the transport is more convenient. Countryside is quiet but, um, it is boring for me. I live in city since I was born so I am used to it.

summary.vi: Trả lời được nhưng ngắn, ngập ngừng; lỗi ngữ pháp cơ bản; từ vựng chung chung.
summary.en: Answers the question but briefly, with hesitation; basic grammar errors; general vocabulary.
summary.ja: 答えてはいるが短くためらいがあり、基本的な文法ミスと一般的な語彙。
summary.ru: Отвечает на вопрос, но кратко и с паузами; базовые грамматические ошибки; общая лексика.

samples.text: I'd say I prefer the city, mainly because it's more convenient. Everything is close, like supermarkets, hospitals and so on, and I can take the bus or the metro to go almost anywhere. The countryside is nice for a short holiday, but I think I would feel a bit bored if I lived there all the time.

summary.vi: Trả lời đủ dài, có lý do và ví dụ; vài chỗ dùng cụm quen thuộc ('and so on'); ngữ pháp chính xác ở mức an toàn.
summary.en: A reasonably extended answer with a reason and examples; some stock phrases ('and so on'); accurate but safe grammar.
summary.ja: 理由と例を含む十分な長さの答え。定型句（'and so on'）があり、文法は正確だが安全運転。
summary.ru: Достаточно развёрнутый ответ с причиной и примерами; есть шаблонные фразы ('and so on'); грамматика точная, но простая.

samples.text: Definitely the city, at least at this stage of my life. I like having everything on my doorstep: if I fancy a bowl of noodles at eleven at night, there's always somewhere open. That said, I can see the appeal of the countryside, especially the fresh air and the slower pace, so maybe when I'm older I'll move somewhere quieter.

summary.vi: Trả lời trôi chảy, có ý phát triển và nhượng bộ; từ vựng tự nhiên ('on my doorstep', 'fancy'); ngữ pháp linh hoạt.

samples.text: For now, the city, without a doubt. I'm someone who thrives on a bit of buzz, and I love that I can finish work, catch a film and grab dinner without ever needing a car. Having said that, every time I visit my grandparents in their village I'm struck by how much more rested I feel, so I wouldn't rule out swapping the noise for some peace and quiet later on.

samples.text: Honestly, it depends which version of me you ask. The weekday me is a city person through and through: I like the anonymity, the late-night noodle stalls, the fact that something's always going on. But the weekend me would happily trade all of that for a cottage with a vegetable patch. So I suppose the ideal would be a city job and a village to escape to, if that's not too greedy.

summary.vi: Hoàn toàn tự nhiên, sáng tạo ('the weekday me / the weekend me'), từ vựng chính xác và giàu sắc thái, ngữ pháp linh hoạt không lỗi.
summary.en: Completely natural and creative ('the weekday me / the weekend me'); precise, nuanced vocabulary; flexible, error-free grammar.
summary.ja: 完全に自然で創造的（'the weekday me / the weekend me'）、正確でニュアンス豊かな語彙、柔軟で誤りのない文法。
